svg.title: Ghori senses the approaching train just before the commuters move.
svg.desc: The tan station dog lies safely back from the track, lifts its notched right ear at a faint rail vibration, and rises one beat before the waiting commuters. Cecil observes the physical cue.
svg.text: Page 28, panel 3 · Low trackside medium shot on Ghori resting near the tea stall

text.tspan: Ghori senses the rail vibration, rises, and moves
one second before the waiting commuters.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
